_doc: The ability keyword system (ROADMAP §4.2): every move = power/cost/acc + 1-2 keywords + numbers, no bespoke scripts. battle/engine.js resolves keyword semantics; this file is the design reference (names/descriptions) plus the data-driven tag chart. Move keyword params: recoil (fraction of damage dealt, self), venom (stacks added), stun/sleep (proc chance), trap/guard/priority/charge/ignoreArmor/ignoreGuard/knockback (true), accUp/accDown/powerUp/powerDown/evasionUp (stat stages, ±15%/stage), staminaRestore (flat), heal (fraction of max HP). tagChart rules: attacker move tag vs defender tag -> mult (0 = misses entirely) or rule 'ignoreArmor'. R20: every keyword here is implemented in battle/engine.js AND carried by at least one move — smoke asserts both, so "Reserved" entries can never accumulate again. Dropped as redundant: reflect (duplicate of thorns); camouflage (duplicate of evasionUp); aoe (the fight is one active per side over a queue; nothing to splash); suppression (already expressible as accDown + multiHit).

keywords.name: Recoil
keywords.desc: The attacker takes a fraction of dealt damage. Enthusiasm has costs.

keywords.name: Venom
keywords.desc: Stacking end-of-turn damage (cap 5). Useless against machinery.

keywords.name: Stun
keywords.desc: Chance the target loses its next turn.

keywords.name: Sleep
keywords.desc: Chance the target naps until it wakes (50%/turn) or is hit.

keywords.name: Trap
keywords.desc: Target cannot switch out while the trapper stays active.

keywords.name: Guard
keywords.desc: Halves damage taken until the user's next action.

keywords.name: Priority
keywords.desc: Moves first regardless of Speed.

keywords.name: Charge
keywords.desc: Spends a turn winding up, hits like a freight train on the next.

keywords.name: Ignore Armor
keywords.desc: Damage bypasses Armor.

keywords.name: Ignore Guard
keywords.desc: Damage bypasses Guard.

keywords.name: Knockback
keywords.desc: Forces the target's side to rotate in a different fighter.

keywords.name: Accuracy Up
keywords.desc: Raises the user's accuracy stage.

keywords.name: Accuracy Down
keywords.desc: Lowers the target's accuracy stage.

keywords.name: Power Up
keywords.desc: Raises the user's power stage.

keywords.name: Power Down
keywords.desc: Lowers the target's power stage.

keywords.name: Evasion Up
keywords.desc: Raises the user's evasion stage.

keywords.name: Stamina Restore
keywords.desc: Refills stamina. Deep breaths. Snack break.

keywords.name: Heal
keywords.desc: Restores a fraction of max HP.

keywords.name: Bleed
keywords.desc: Stacking end-of-turn damage (cap 4). Unlike Venom it works on machinery.

keywords.name: Slow
keywords.desc: Cuts the target's Speed for the rest of the fight.

keywords.name: Taunt
keywords.desc: The target can only choose moves that hit back — no breather, no tag-out.

keywords.name: Thorns
keywords.desc: The user returns a share of any damage it takes. Touching it is a decision.

keywords.name: Multi-Hit
keywords.desc: Strikes 2..N times at the listed power each, armor applying to every hit.

keywords.name: Frenzy
keywords.desc: Damage grows as the TARGET's health falls. Blood in the water.

keywords.name: Rally
keywords.desc: Raises the power stage of the user's whole side, not just the one swinging.

keywords.name: Regen
keywords.desc: Restores a share of max HP at end of turn for three turns.

keywords.name: Rage
keywords.desc: Damage grows as the USER's own health falls.

keywords.name: Stamina Drain
keywords.desc: Takes stamina off the target and gives the user half of it.

keywords.name: Lock-On
keywords.desc: Ignores every way of not being there: evasion stage, Skittish, scars.
